name: <<Inreal'nost'>>
source: The protagonist, Konstantin, is a mid-level accountant at the main office of ZAO <<Polymer>>. He's callous, distrustful, hot-tempered, and two-faced. The only thing he would like is to start living anew, to forget his past and live in the present. But is he ready for what he will have to do for this? Will his life change? And the main question is, can you trust anyone? Be afraid of your desires, because they can appear in the most cruel and perverted form. Can an ordinary day after work turn out like this?
translation: 主人公康斯坦丁是ZAO《高分子》总公司的中级会计师。他冷酷无情、多疑、脾气暴躁、有两面性。他唯一想要的就是开始新的生活，忘记过去，活在当下。但他准备好为此所做的一切了吗？他的生活会改变吗？主要问题是，你能相信任何人吗？害怕你的欲望，因为它们可能以最残酷和最变态的形式出现。平凡的一天下班后能变成这样吗？
